target_description: Clean-room Centipede-inspired arcade game, touch-first and playable on iPhone Safari; deployed via GitHub Pages at https://github.com/wdavidpence/cenitpede-clone

checklist.item: Phase 0 baseline — repo identity and architecture plan documented
checklist.notes: README.md present; docs/architecture.md and docs/project-plan.md authored

checklist.item: Phase 1 vertical slice — playable game loop with player, mushrooms, centipede, collisions, scoring
checklist.notes: CRITICAL FIX (this pass): player-centipede collision now checks ALL segments, not just heads. Body segments were previously non-lethal — a gameplay regression vs authentic Centipede. Fixed by iterating all segments in collision loop.

checklist.item: Phase 2 enemy ecology — segment behavior, head turns, spider/flea/scorpion interactions
checklist.notes: Spider distance-based scoring (300/600/900). Flea spawns mushrooms. Scorpion poisons mushrooms. All verified via scorecard PASS and smoke PASS.

checklist.item: Phase 3 rules and cabinet feel — scoring, audio, particles, HUD, graphics polish
checklist.notes: CRITICAL FIX (this pass): removed duplicate CRT overlay. CSS #crt div (scanlines+vignette) and canvas drawCrtOverlay() were both rendering, causing doubled/darker effect. Removed canvas version; CSS handles it at correct z-index. Wave-clear bonus: 10 pts per remaining mushroom. 12 Web Audio sounds. Parallax depth layer. Particle FX capped at 80.

checklist.item: Phase 4 iPhone Safari hardening — touch-action, safe-area, orientation
checklist.notes: Orientation lock with fallback. Fullscreen on user gesture. Safe-area layout. DPR capped at 2. NOT verified on real device.

checklist.item: Phase 5 — progression depth and attract mode
checklist.notes: Wave transitions verified. Bonus waves every 5 waves. Document visibility API handler pauses/resumes animation loop.

checklist.item: Phase 6 — Retina/backing store, visibility guard, wave bonus
checklist.notes: DPR-aware canvas: canvas.width/height = W*DPR, H*DPR; ctx.scale(DPR,DPR). CSS stays 320x240 logical. DPR = min(devicePixelRatio,2). visibilitychange listener pauses/resumes with acc reset. Wave-clear bonus awarded in real code path.

checklist.item: Autonomous loop infrastructure — STATE.json + supervisor.sh + docs/autonomous-loop.md

last_test_report.command: node scorecard.js && node tests/smoke.mjs && python3 -c "import json;json.load(open("STATE.json"))" && git diff --check
last_test_report.details: scorecard ALL markers true (touch predicate passes). smoke PASS (325 assertions). inline JS compiles. STATE.json parses cleanly. git diff --check clean. touch marker added to scorecard.js: checks for touchstart/touchmove/touchend/touchcancel tokens AND joystickArea or .fireBtn/joystickThumb control.

next_action: Remaining items for 100: real-device verification needed for DPR rendering on Retina, visibility API pause/resume on iOS Safari backgrounding, touch-start flow from attract mode to game start, fullscreen API behavior on iOS Safari, safe-area-inset padding, orientation lock. Optional: devicePixelRatio change listener.
